Row 5 has two cells
whose only notes are 3 and 8.
If the left cell is 3, the right cell is 8.
If the left cell is 8, the right cell is 3.
Either way, these two cells
share 3 and 8 between them.
So neither 3 nor 8 can go
in the other cells of this row.
Sometimes three cells
